title: Everything you don’t want it to do
text:
This app was amazing when I downloaded it… then an update came and ruined the entire app completely!!!
The update added ai a entirely new user interface that is impossible to understand because the layout just makes zero sense everything is all over the place. Have had times where I’ve had to make a invoice over and over and over again because it just wouldn’t save had an invoice that completely broke and wouldn’t let me make changes and would say “malfunction” without an error code or anything that I’m particularly invoice ended up making me look bad to my customer and ultimately resulted in me not getting paid. It’s to the point where every time I need to use this app I’m presented with a new issue that practically makes the app unusable seriously if your running a business and care about that businesses reputation USE ANY OTHER METHOD TO DO INVOICES.
